newsitem.title: UK: Fenner says current trade encouraging.
newsitem.headline: Fenner says current trade encouraging.

text.p: UK power equipment manufacturer Fenner Plc said its current year's trade was encouraging and was realising the effects of recent investments in its conveyor belt division.

Addressing shareholders at the company's annual general meeting, chairman Colin Cooke said the strength of sterling would affect Fenner's overseas earnings in the current year but it would not prevent further progress during the period.
"I believe that the group will continue to report further progress during the current year," said Cooke.
Fenner had recently acquired the business of Nationwide Belting of Toledo in Ohio which provided the company with a manufacturing base in the north American market.
